tool_schemas.name: fetch_html
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the resource at the provided URL and returns the response body as HTML along with normalized response metadata (final URL, HTTP status, timing, and content-type/length) recorded for auditing, caching, and quota enforcement. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid or headers is not an object of string values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exhausted its allowed fetches. Raises FETCH_FAILED when the upstream request cannot be completed (e.g., DNS/connection/timeout/TLS errors), and returns an error for non-success upstream HTTP statuses instead of HTML.

url.description: URL of the website to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

tool_schemas.name: fetch_markdown
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the resource at the provided URL and returns a Markdown rendition of the fetched content plus normalized response metadata (final URL, HTTP status, timing, and content-type/length) recorded for auditing, caching, and quota enforcement. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid or headers is not an object of string values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exhausted its allowed fetches. Raises FETCH_FAILED when the upstream request cannot be completed (e.g., DNS/connection/timeout/TLS errors), and returns an error for non-success upstream HTTP statuses or when the response cannot be converted to Markdown.

url.description: URL of the website to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

tool_schemas.name: fetch_txt
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the resource at the provided URL and returns plain text extracted from the response (no HTML) plus normalized response metadata (final URL, HTTP status, timing, and content-type/length) recorded for auditing, caching, and quota enforcement. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid or headers is not an object of string values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exhausted its allowed fetches. Raises FETCH_FAILED when the upstream request cannot be completed (e.g., DNS/connection/timeout/TLS errors), and returns an error for non-success upstream HTTP statuses or when text extraction is not possible.

url.description: URL of the website to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

tool_schemas.name: fetch_json
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the resource at the provided URL and returns the parsed JSON value plus normalized response metadata (final URL, HTTP status, timing, and content-type/length) recorded for auditing, caching, and quota enforcement. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid or headers is not an object of string values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exhausted its allowed fetches. Raises FETCH_FAILED when the upstream request cannot be completed (e.g., DNS/connection/timeout/TLS errors), and returns INVALID_JSON when the response body is not valid JSON or when the upstream returns a non-success HTTP status.

url.description: URL of the JSON to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity (api_client) along with effective scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key is provided; raises FORBIDDEN if the client is not permitted to use the service.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (e.g., passed as a bearer token or header value in the vendor API; provided here explicitly for tooling).

tool_schemas.name: list_fetch_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded fetch requests for the authenticated client, with filtering by status, time range, and URL. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid/revoked; raises FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/deleted.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of fetch requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

url_contains.description: Filter to requests whose original url contains this substring.

url_normalized.description: Filter by the canonicalized URL value stored as url_normalized.

created_after.description: Only include requests created after this time (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only include requests created before this time (inclusive).

tool_name.description: Filter by the tool that created the request.

tool_schemas.name: get_fetch_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single fetch request by id, including its stored request metadata (url, url_normalized, headers, status, timing fields). Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the authenticated client; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

fetch_request_id.description: ID of the fetch request to retrieve.

include_response.description: If true, also returns the linked fetch response if it exists.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_fetch_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running fetch request. Transitions status to cancelled when allowed by the lifecycle; refuses cancellation for requests already succeeded/failed/cancelled. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the authenticated client; raises CONFLICT if the transition is not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

fetch_request_id.description: ID of the fetch request to cancel.

tool_schemas.name: list_host_access_policies
tool_schemas.description: Lists host access policies effective for the authenticated client (client-scoped rules), optionally filtered by status and host pattern. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of policies to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_host_access_policy
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new host access policy or updates an existing one for the authenticated client. Enables allow/deny rules and supports lifecycle transitions between active and disabled. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid host_pattern or policy; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

host_access_policy_id.description: If provided, updates the existing policy by id; otherwise creates a new policy.

policy.description: Whether matching hosts are allowed or denied.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the rule (audit trail).

metadata.name: Fetch Server
metadata.description: Fetch Server is a lightweight HTTP fetching backend that retrieves content from URLs and returns it as HTML, Markdown, plain text, or parsed JSON. The backend stores API clients/keys, individual fetch requests (including headers), and normalized fetch responses with status, timing, and content metad
